description: Land Acquisition - Rajagiriya, Sri ayawardenepura Kotte D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations for public purpose acquisition. It falls under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land-related matters including property descriptions, boundaries, and acquisition procedures, without involving government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
